title: Dualization of encoded gates
statement: For every finite list $G$ of gates and every finite bit string $r$, processing the encoding of $G$ followed by $r$ from state $g$ yields the encoding of the list obtained by replacing each gate with its dual, followed by the unchanged suffix $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a finite list of gates
